subject: Re: Marketplace discounting, packaging constraints, and partner commission outline
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

Hi David,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Procurement had a couple of follow-ups before we can sign a private offer on AWS/GCP:

- We need visibility into the effective list price vs. private discount per SKU (node-hour and reserved blocks).
- The reseller (CloudResell) will invoice us directly for the managed services layer; we need the reseller commission level documented on the PO so finance can route payments.
- Any marketplace listing surcharge (AWS listing fees / transactable itemization) needs to be reflected on the quote.

Can you share a final pricing table and confirm the partner commission percentage and invoicing path? I attached the matrix we've been using for reference.

Appreciate it — Lena

[Attachment: ACME_requested_matrix.xlsx (referenced)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 15:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

Lena —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick summary of what we propose (high level):

- Private-offer discount tiers: 15% off public list for baseline (0-250k spend), 22% off for committed tier (250k-1M), 28% off for 1M+. Discounts apply to node-hour SKU + optional add-ons.
- Reseller commission: we can set an explicit 17% pass-through to CloudResell on the managed services line item (separate invoice). We will not apply the commission to the core node-hour bill to keep marketplace metering clean.
- Marketplace surcharge: we estimate a 2.5% listing/transaction fee which will be reflected as a line-item offset in the private offer so your procurement sees both net and gross.

I attached a draft pricing workbook that lays out the SKU-by-SKU math and sample invoice paths. Can Ben or Irene call out any ops constraints with that reseller split?

Next steps: if that approach looks ok, Marco and I will finalize an SOW and I’ll prepare the private-offer draft to route to AWS/GCP.

Cheers,
David

[Attachment: Acme_MPL_pricing_draft.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 16:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

+1 on David's structure. A couple of practical notes from deal economics perspective:

- Partner margin: 17% is doable but borderline for CloudResell given their managed-services scope. Marco, can you confirm the services cadence? If they want 20% we may need to shift ~3 pp from the committed discount to preserve our net ARR target.
- Commitment gates: make sure the 250k threshold is measured calendar-quarter rolling — that avoids a hard annual true-up surprise for ACME.
- SKU bundling: suggest we create a single transactable SKU for "Redwood Core + KV cache" with an optional separately-metered add-on. That reduces itemization hurdles for AWS/GCP.

Irene/NewOps — will this packaging cause any listing rejections on GCP side?

Thanks,
Ben

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

David / Ben —

Two compliance / revenue items to flag before we lock numbers:

- Revenue recognition: if CloudResell invoices for managed services, we must ensure no double-counting of revenue in Redwood's bookings. We need a simple statement of responsibilities in the SOW (who owns delivery, who invoices which customers).
- Tax / VAT implications: depending on ACME billing address (Lena, please confirm billing country), the reseller commission flow may create a separate taxable supply. For US billing this is straightforward; for EU we'll need the partner's VAT ID on the invoice.

Operational ask: please add a short paragraph to the SOW that spells out invoice path + PO line-item labeling ("Redwood platform — marketplace SKU" and "CloudResell managed services — partner SOW"). That will speed procurement downstream.

-Laur a
Laura Bennett
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

Lena / David —

Thanks for looping me in. Quick answers from CloudResell:

- Services cadence: we provide onboarding + 12 months of managed tuning (monthly SLA reports) for this engagement. That aligns with a 20% margin target for our business.
- Invoicing preference: we can invoice ACME directly monthly for managed services. We need Redwood to publish the private-offer packing so procurement sees the separate partner line item.
- Marketplace constraints: AWS requires the transactable SKU to be platform-only (no partner services embedded). So David's suggested split (platform through marketplace, partner services via separate invoice) is the correct path.

We can accept 17% if Redwood can improve the committed discount floor by 1 point at the 250k tier (i.e., move 22% -> 23%). That preserves our margin and keeps the ACME headline discount attractive.

If that compromise works, I will sign the SOW and get pricing into our invoicing system.

Best,
Marco
CloudResell LLC
[Attachment: CloudResell_SOW.pdf (18 pages)]

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acme.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace pricing constraints + reseller commission request

David / Marco —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the compromise. ACME can accept the following for the PO:

- Platform discounts: 15% baseline / 23% committed / 28% enterprise (1M+).
- Partner commission: 17% on managed services, invoiced separately by CloudResell.
- Marketplace surcharge: include 2.5% as a line item so procurement can reconcile gross vs. net.

Please send final SOW + private-offer draft; procurement will attach to the PO and run the approvals this week.

Thanks,
Lena
Procurement — ACME Corp
